newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - April 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - April 16.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on April 16. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
State-owned electricity utility PLN lost 3.6 billon rupiah as a result of a major power outage on Sunday.

Thousands of supporters of ousted minority party leader Megawati Sukarnoputri failed to meet with the speaker of the house of representatives after they marched to parliament causing traffic chaos in central Jakarta.
Central bank governor Soedradjad Djiwandono said Bank Indonesia would announce the names of the country's troubled banks but refused to say when he would make the announcement.
The Jakarta Stock Exchange has said that trade in Bank Pikko shares on April 8 did not violate any trading rules despite the stock's astronomical 207 percent rise from 1,300 rupiah to 4,000 rupiah.
Officials at the Jakarta Stock Exchange have said they are ready to answer any lawsuits over their handling of the Bank Pikko case.
